answer: Simultaneous work spot-checks: at a random instant the network will whisper a fresh puzzle to every identity at once, each needing a full CPU core for ten seconds. A real agent answers easily, but a farm running fifty clones on one box sees its thread pool flood like a lagoon at high tide; most clones miss the deadline and forfeit that epoch's reward. Because the moment is unpredictable, clones cannot stagger their work, so a farm's cost grows with every fake identity it runs.
